tg_clinic_sailor: Sixty years I read this channel. Currents, colour, how the birds sit on it.
Now it is flat as a table, and I have never had to read a table before.
A flat sea is not a calm sea. A flat sea is a held one, and something is holding it.
tg_clinic_pilot: Thirty-one thousand people and I can name the four who worry me.
Not one of them is a Foundation man. That is the part I keep chewing.
They are the ones who stopped asking questions, and they all stopped in the same month.
